title: Fuselage — Fwd Lower Shell Lap Joint — High Frequency Eddy Current Inspection Before Strap Installation
abstract: Mandatory high frequency eddy current inspection of the forward lower shell lap joint fastener rows, required by airworthiness directive and used as the entry condition for the bonded strap installation.

sections.planning_reason: Cracking from the outer fastener row of the forward lower shell lap joint has been reported on high-cycle aircraft, including aircraft that had already been re-sealed. Seventeen findings were recorded between 2017 and 2019. Because a crack that has grown past the strap footprint cannot be covered by the strap, the joint must be inspected and cleared before the strap is installed. The airworthiness authority made this inspection mandatory and repetitive until the strap is embodied.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin gives a high frequency eddy current inspection of both fastener rows of the forward lower shell longitudinal lap joint between stations 1080 and 1360 on each side of the aircraft, performed from the outside with the paint removed locally. It defines the acceptance criteria, the reporting requirement and the repeat interval that applies until the bonded strap standard is embodied.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Put the aircraft on jacks and remove the paint from a 60 millimetre band centred on each fastener row between stations 1080 and 1360. Calibrate the eddy current equipment on the reference block and record the calibration. Scan both fastener rows on the left and the right side. Any indication longer than 3 millimetres makes the joint unserviceable and must be reported to Aeralis before further flight. Where the joint is clear, restore the surface protection and the paint scheme. Record the inspection and the date. Repeat this inspection every 4500 flight cycles until the bonded strap of the related modification bulletin is installed. Where the strap is installed at the same visit, this inspection is the entry condition and does not have to be repeated afterwards.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to ZEPHYR-20 and ZEPHYR-22 aircraft in the MSN range Z00051 to Z03884 that are not yet at the bonded strap standard. One aircraft is excluded because it was withdrawn from service before the effective date. Aircraft delivered after the range are not affected.
sections.material_note: No kit is required. Consumables are limited to paint stripper, surface protection and the paint scheme materials. The inspection is a partial embodiment of the related modification and carries no weight change of its own; the mass increase is recorded against the strap installation bulletin.

type_data.compliance_time: Within 1500 flight cycles after the effective date of the airworthiness directive, and thereafter every 4500 flight cycles until the bonded strap is installed.

tooling: Eddy current equipment with 2 MHz pencil probe
